Of the verbs having the sense of 'motion', 'knowledge or information' and 'eating' and of verbs that have some literary work for their object and of intransitive verbs, that which was the agent of the verb in its primitive (non-णि or non-causal state), is called the कर्म or object, in its causative state (when the verb takes the affix णि).

Terms: कारक-कर्म-संज्ञा

The words प्र etc. are called also गति when in composition with a verb.

Terms: उपसर्ग-संज्ञा

In the case of roots implying motion, the place which the motion is directed takes the affix of the 2nd (Accusative) or the 4th (Dative) case in denoting the 'object', when physical motion is meant and the object is not a word expressing 'road'.

Terms: विभक्ति-2, 4
There is लुक् elision of the affix सिच् -- च्लेः सिच्
in the prSmEpd after the verbs गा 'to go', स्था 'to stand', the verbs called घु मृषस्तितिक्षायाम्

, पा 'to drink' and भू 'to be'.

Terms: सिच्-elision

And the word गत्वर is irregularly formed.

Terms: Irregular

The affix क्त is used in denoting the agent as well as the act and the object after verbs implying motion after intransitive roots and after the verbs 1. श्लिष् 'to embrace' 2. शि 'to lie down' 3. स्था 'to stand' 4. आस् 'to sit' 5. वस् 'to dwell' 6. जन् 'to produce' 7. रुह् 'to mount' 8. जृ 'to grow old'.

Terms: क्त

, when standing immediately before a Participle in क्त having a Passive significance, retains its accent.

Terms: समास accent
In a तत्-पुरुष समास a word ending in a कृत् affix preserves its original accent when preceded by an indeclinable called गति -- गतिश्च
, or a noun standing in intimate relation to a verb (कारक) or any word which gives occasion for compounding (उपपद -- तत्रोपपदं सप्तमीस्थम्‌

The लृट् (I Future) retains its accent in connection with the Imperative of a verb denoting 'motion' ('to go', 'to come', 'to start' etc.) but only in that case, when the subject and object of both the verbs are not wholly different one from another.

Terms: Accent

A गति becomes unaccented when followed by another गति .

Terms: Accent
